INV-001: Every accepted user turn must receive a trace_id.
INV-002: A cognition event may not be marked valid unless required perception/state inputs exist.
INV-003: A visual-capability claim requires verified visual input evidence.
INV-004: A fallback activation must be explicitly recorded.
INV-005: Required modules cannot silently disappear from a trace.
INV-006: Every event must have a valid parent/root relationship.
INV-007: Hardware execution status must be distinguishable from hardware availability.
INV-008: A completed turn must have a terminal outcome.
INV-009: Certification evidence must originate from an actual production execution path and must not be synthesized by the verification suite.
